latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Transform raw video footage into edited, ready-to-post videos with AI automation.

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM files (up to 500MB) and describe the desired edits for fully automated processing.
- Exports high-quality 1080p MP4 files, free of charge, optimized for fast turnaround.
- No manual timeline work needed — just describe edits like trimming pauses or adding transitions.
- Simple session and token-based connection to the backend API; handles credits and error states automatically.
- Supports multiple workflows: quick edits, batch processing, and iterative refinements with real-time state tracking.
